<thought>Search the template catalog for a retrosynthetic template that converts a trimethylsilyl‑protected alcohol back to the free alcohol, i.e., breaks an aliphatic hydroxyl (O‑H) and forms a trimethylsilyl group. Use the functional group criteria “aliphatic hydroxyls” (broken) and “trimethylsilyl” (formed). Once a template is found, retrieve its mapped reaction SMILES and template ID.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["aliphatic hydroxyls"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["trimethylsilyl"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
